ːretrowaveː Here are the changes that should delight night runners ːretrowaveː

[b]->[/b] A Leaderboard window now is available in the statistics section.
[b]->[/b] A success window is now available in the statistics section.
[b]->[/b] The menu UI can now be hidden with the F1 key.
[b]->[/b] Headlights of cars with popup headlights are now animated.
[b]->[/b] The Simplified Chinese translation has been reworked by a real translator.
[b]->[/b] The Traditional Chinese translation has been reworked by a real translator
[b]->[/b] The "VAZ" car has been added.
[b]->[/b] The "COMET 4" car has been added.
[b]->[/b] 4 new rims have been added.
[b]->[/b] Skins are now available on the COMET.
[b]->[/b] Most of the bugs mentioned by players have been fixed, like:
[b]->[/b] The game detects again when the player is going the opposite direction on the road.
[b]->[/b] A small indication has been added on the game radios that specifies that you can change music with the "M" key on the keyboard.
